convention: All GLBs normalized: +Y up, +Z forward, +X = car's left, meters (bbox length == lengthMeters), tire bottom at y=0, x/z centered on bbox. Hierarchy: <id> > body > body_mesh, and wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr pivot nodes (translation = wheel center, identity rotation/scale, axle along X) each with a child wheel_xx_mesh. Rotate the wheel_xx node about local X to spin and about local Y to steer. Geometry: EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization (GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder). Textures: EXT_texture_webp, max 1024px.
